description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rekindling Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
When Rekindling Phoenix dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Rekindling Phoenix trigger, creating a 0/1 Elemental creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Rekindling Phoenix from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
